ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution; approximately 75% high-intensity white central area versus 25% low-intensity black perimeter and localized markings.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity white contiguous zones across the mid-sections of both lobes. Low-intensity black pigmentation is concentrated along the entire trailing edge margin, the central fluke base (peduncle attachment), and appearing as vertical striations extending upward from the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 50 degrees and a vertical pixel depth reaching approximately 15% of the visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serration; numerous sharp peaks and valleys along the entire margin. Amplitude of serrations increases significantly towards the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edge, tapering to sharp distal points with a slight upward sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed, low-intensity dark clusters localized on the extreme outer tips (left and right) corresponding to irregular surface texture/barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Significant linear disruptions. Left lobe: sequence of 7-9 parallel diagonal black lines. Right lobe: multiple intersecting linear marks, including a prominent 'X' or 'V' shaped intersection on the upper mid-lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake marks (parallel linear scars) on both lobes; significant irregular massing and texture distortion at the distal tips indicative of parasitic colonization or previous trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced vertical black 'drip' patterns originating from the central base and extending into the high-intensity white zones.
